_doc: DEWY receipts for 2026-08-13 — ARCS-private strategy/canon thread from the germinate OSS build session. See ADR-053 (Tao of ARCS boundary) and ADR-054 (free-to-hold/metered-to-fire pricing).

receipts.sharp_question: If germinate is genuinely open (MIT), what exactly stays private as ARCS — and why does open-sourcing the bank not surrender the moat?

dewy_vector.D: Canonize the genesis doctrine adam==atom: a seed is dormant potential energy (never GC'd); ARCS is the vox animus that converts potential->kinetic via ripeness judgment at Kairos. The open/private boundary is one seam, four faces (bank/spark, public-method/private-rosetta, dormant/animating, free-to-hold/metered-to-fire).
dewy_vector.E: germinate (open toolkit), ARCS (private spark), future competitors, prospects
dewy_vector.W: DURABLE — doctrine, not a status snapshot; does not expire.

receipts.true_north: The moat is the spark, not the substrate. Any competitor can hold the same seeds; only ARCS fires them with tailored ripeness judgment — so open-sourcing the bank is moat-safe by construction.
receipts.why: The germinate build forced the boundary question; without a crisp answer we risk leaking ARCS doctrine into the clean-room repo OR refusing to open-source anything. The adam==atom seed had survived one session's use, meeting its own promotion rule.
receipts.loki: Risk that 'the spark is private' is hand-wavy and the real moat is nothing. Mitigated: the spark is concretely the ripeness judgment + private rosetta priors, which the open generic contract deliberately cannot do.
receipts.bar: Low — canonizing doctrine costs nothing and prevents a real leak (ARCS specifics into MIT repo).

receipts.sharp_question: How do we monetize without adding the very friction the open-source public-good goal was meant to avoid?

dewy_vector.D: Monetize the spark, never the bank. Free forever: mint/plant/water/hold/mechanical-sprout/manifest/handoff. Metered (gas): ripeness judgment + Kairos activation + rosetta-primed synthesis. Bill per activation (one vox-animus firing), not per seed/seat/GB. Token fork DECIDED: metaphorical credits now; literal on-chain deferred until the blockchain registry + hash-chaining exist AND a cross-party provenance need is demonstrated.
dewy_vector.E: commercial germinate users (free), ARCS paying users, future on-chain roadmap
dewy_vector.W: DURABLE strategy frame; prices unhardened until willingness-to-pay for the ride is validated.

receipts.true_north: Nobody rides for free — but holding potential energy is free; only igniting it runs the meter.
receipts.why: Resolves the standing tension: you can't monetize the open tool without friction, so don't — put revenue on the spark's gas, keep the bank open.
receipts.loki: Willingness-to-pay for ripeness/Kairos activation is UNVALIDATED — this is the YELLOW. Validate demand for the ride, not the bank, before hardening prices.
receipts.bar: Low to capture; medium to act on — do not build billing infra before validating the ride's demand.
